output.answer_markdown: Yes. Boeing's filings state that the airline industry has traditionally been cyclical, with significant profit swings [1]. Boeing's Commercial Airplanes and Global Services businesses depend heavily on commercial airlines, which the filings identify as a source of risk [2].

provenance.quote: Traditionally, the airline industry has been cyclical and very competitive and has experienced significant profit swings and constant challenges to be more cost competitive.

claims.text: The airline industry has traditionally been cyclical and has experienced significant profit swings.

provenance.quote: Our Commercial Airplanes and Global Services businesses depend heavily on commercial airlines, and are subject to unique risks.

claims.text: Boeing's Commercial Airplanes and Global Services businesses depend heavily on commercial airlines.
